rationale: C24 is the strongest drafting template because the child continues the same proclamation series, repeats its detailed statutory and treaty background, carries forward its recital-based amendment machinery, and uses substantially the same multipart operative structure for applying concessions, rectifying schedules, and amending the Cuba tariff lists. The child expressly identifies the March 8, 1949 proclamation and its annexed Second Protocol of Rectifications, then adapts C24's machinery to later statutory changes and a correction to item 708(a). C07 and C21 are also close predecessors in the same drafting lineage, but C24 is the latest and most directly incorporated model.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas pursuant to the authority vested in the President by the Constitution and the statutes, including section 350 of the Tariff Act of 1930 ... on October 30, 1947, the President entered into a trade agreement with the Governments of [the same listed countries] ... which trade agreement consists of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the related Protocol of Provisional Application thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas, pursuant to the authority vested in the President by the Constitution and statutes, including section 350 of the Tariff Act of 1930 ... on October 30, 1947 the President entered into a trade agreement with the Governments of [the same listed countries] ... which trade agreement consists of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the related Protocol of Provisional Application thereof
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C24's unusually detailed opening recital, including the same authority, agreement date, parties, and description of the GATT instruments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas by Proclamation No. 2761A of December 16, 1947 ... which proclamation has been supplemented by [the series through] March 8, 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas, on December 16, 1947, by Proclamation 2761A ... which proclamation has been supplemented by [the series through July 15, 1948]
shared_material.explanation: The child extends C24's cumulative-history recital by appending C24 itself, a hallmark of reuse within the same proclamation series.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas item 708(a) in Part I of Schedule XX in the Second Protocol of Rectifications to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, of September 14, 1948, a copy of which is annexed to the said proclamation on March 8, 1949, was inadvertently misstated
shared_material.parent_excerpt: said trade agreement ... was also supplemented on September 14, 1948 by: (a) a Second Protocol of Rectifications to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade ... a copy of which ... is annexed to this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The child's correction provision directly depends on the protocol introduced and annexed through C24, making the relationship more than merely topical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: PART I To the end that the said trade agreement specified in the first recital ... may be carried out ... PART II To the end that the said trade agreement ... and the said exclusive trade agreement ... may be carried out ... PART III To the end that the said trade agreement specified in the third recital ... may be carried out
shared_material.parent_excerpt: PART I To the end that said trade agreement specified in the 1st recital ... may be carried out ... Part II To the end that said exclusive trade agreement specified in the 3rd recital ... may be carried out
shared_material.explanation: Both use numbered parts keyed to earlier recitals to separate general-agreement concessions and rectifications from amendments implementing the exclusive Cuba agreement.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the list set forth in the ninth recital of the said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended, shall ... be further amended in the manner indicated in the ninth recital of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the list set forth in the 9th recital of said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended and rectified, shall on and after March 16, 1949 be further amended in the manner indicated in the 9th recital of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: This is substantially identical operative machinery for amending the same incorporated tariff list by reference to a determination recital.
